name: ÅF Cube Days 2015
information: A two-day competition open for everyone, but limited to 40 participants per day. Each day is scheduled as a "stand alone" day;rnrnSaturday 10.00-17.00: 3x3 Blind, Clock, Pyraminx, Skewb, 3x3 OH and Sq-1.rnSunday 10.00-17.00: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 and 5x5.rnrnParticipation fee for one or two days: 100 SEK. For Swedish participants the registration is valid as soon as the fee is paid to the Swish account 072 370 07 75. Or pay to bank account: SHB Clearing number: 6845 account: 150 082 282. Note your name when you pay. Non-Swedish participant can pay at registration.rnrnRegistration closes October 12th.rnrnThe fee goes to Svekub for equipment costs, etc. More detailed will be found on the competition homepage later on.
